fb_text:
7:52 AM. Your new guy is at the gate. Your phone doesn't ring.

That used to be how every morning started. "Hey boss, what's the gate code at the Riverside office?" And you're digging through a text thread from March while your coffee goes cold.

Now the code lives in FieldNotes. He asks the bot. It answers. He works. You drink the coffee while it's hot.

Every gate code, access note, and client quirk lives in one place — and your crew gets answers without calling you.

I built it for my own commercial plant service — 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area. The day the morning calls stopped is the day I knew it worked.

Try the 60-second demo — ask it the gate code yourself:
fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
